local P=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local H=game:GetService("HttpService")
local gui=P.PlayerGui
local found={}
for _,x in gui:GetDescendants() do
 if x.Name=="ClassPortrait" or (x:IsA("ImageLabel") and x.Parent and x.Parent.Name=="Portrait") then
 table.insert(found,{name=x.Name,image=x.Image,visible=x.Visible,loaded=x.IsLoaded,rect_offset={x.ImageRectOffset.X,x.ImageRectOffset.Y},rect_size={x.ImageRectSize.X,x.ImageRectSize.Y},absolute_size={x.AbsoluteSize.X,x.AbsoluteSize.Y}})
 end
end
return H:JSONEncode({faction=P:GetAttribute("Faction"),class=P:GetAttribute("Class"),gender=P:GetAttribute("CharacterGender"),enabled=P:GetAttribute("CostumeEnabled"),portraits=found})
